provider.name: UniProt Taxonomy
provider.organization_type: global protein-linked taxonomy, identifier, lineage, organism-code, proteome, REST API, SPARQL, RDF, bulk-download, and cross-reference infrastructure
provider.description: UniProt Taxonomy provides the organismal classification used across UniProtKB, proteomes, UniRef, and UniParc. It exposes TaxIDs, scientific and alternate names, ranks, parent-child relationships, lineages, organism mnemonics, host associations, merged and deleted identifiers, protein and proteome relationships, REST API services, SPARQL/RDF access, and bulk downloads.
institutional_context: NCBI Taxonomy and other linked biological authorities

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting UniProt Taxonomy documentation, organization, taxonomy records, names, ranks, lineages, organism mnemonics, host data, merge and deletion history, UniProtKB and proteome relationships, REST API, SPARQL, RDF, downloads, formats, quality control, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: UniProt, the UniProt Consortium, official REST and SPARQL documentation, release files, RDF schemas, NCBI Taxonomy and other source authorities, official repositories, and cited publications remain authoritative for TaxIDs, names, lineages, mappings, versions, rights, and contacts.
